policyPlanner: Authorized operator only; immutable exact A/B bytes+fixed current/target ChannelProof/DER+same R/root in signed intent; runtime cannot generate or reauthorize

admissionReleaseOrdering: Admission plannedReleaseId reserves the future release identity; no FK to an already existing release. Activation atomically inserts release with all-five final admission evidence and exact planned ID; effective current joins require that committed record.
quiescence: Commit durable global fence, stop new role-use issuance, wait prior <=120s grants plus skew expiry, prove all-five no in-flight execution/transfer/terminal/sampling/active leases or second state consumers before any live exposure. Unknown blocks.
